_readme: Tai chi routine: 15 movements, 1 minute each, played back to back. Order is the order they run in. 'image' is a looping animated line figure of the movement (see make-illustrations.py) — swap in real footage whenever you're ready, and just replace the file each name points to. 'cue' is a one-sentence how-to shown under the picture, as in posture.json.

movements.name: Lymphatic hops
movements.cue: Stay loose and bounce lightly on the balls of your feet. Let your arms and shoulders shake out as you land.

movements.name: Body waves
movements.cue: Reach both arms up tall, then roll down through your chest, belly and hips as your knees bend. Rise back up in one smooth wave.

movements.name: Arm swings
movements.cue: Feet hip width apart. Swing one arm forward and up as the other swings back and down. Keep the arms long and relaxed.

movements.name: Trunk twists
movements.cue: Feet wide, knees soft. Turn from the waist and let both arms swing round to one side, then the other. Your head follows the turn.

movements.name: Forward arm circles
movements.cue: Arms straight and relaxed. Draw big circles around your body: open them out and up the sides, cross them overhead, then sweep them down in front of you.

movements.name: Squats
movements.cue: Feet a little wider than your hips. Sit back and down as if onto a chair, chest up, then press through your heels to stand.

movements.name: Backward arm circles
movements.cue: The same big circles in reverse: cross your arms low in front of your body, sweep them up the middle overhead, then open out and down the sides.

movements.name: Dead arms
movements.cue: Arms completely loose, like ropes. Let them fling open wide and wrap back across your chest on their own.

movements.name: Golf swings
movements.cue: Swing your arms across your body from low on one side to high on the other, like a golf swing. Let your hips and back heel turn with it.

movements.name: Marches
movements.cue: Lift one knee high as your arms open wide, then close your arms around the raised knee. Lower the leg and switch sides.

movements.name: Tiptoe arm swings
movements.cue: Swing your arms low behind you, then up overhead as you rise onto your toes. Lower your heels as the arms come down.

movements.name: Twist the waist
movements.cue: Feet planted, turn your waist to one side and let one arm reach out long. Turn back through the centre to the other side.

movements.name: Wide arm step backs
movements.cue: Arms out in front of you. Step one foot back into a small lunge as your arms open out wide at shoulder height. Step the foot back in as the arms close, then switch sides.

movements.name: Back step wave lunges
movements.cue: Step back into a lunge and sweep both arms up and over to one side in a wave. Return to standing and switch sides.

movements.name: Ballet squats
movements.cue: Feet wide, toes turned out. Lower into the squat as your arms float down in front of you, then rise and lift them up overhead.
